evidence: Cic. Off. 2.60: nāvālia, portūs, aquārum ductūs (Lewis & Short s.v. nāvālis)
terms.comment: A place where ships were built and repaired; plural, the singular nāvāle is poetic (Lewis & Short).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 169.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
